subject: MAP: POC network & secrets gating — owners, timeline, target close
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sean O'Rourke <sean@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC network & secrets gating — owners, timeline, target close

Hi Sean — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed next-step plan so we have one place of truth for the MAP milestone around environment setup (network, SSO, secrets). I attached a draft MAP (MAP_v1.3.pdf) and a small allowlist template. Please confirm owners and any missing constraints.

High-level target: get POC environment reachable and authenticated by 2027-09-02 (target close), so you can validate throughput and costs in your staging workload the week of 9/6.

Key dependencies & proposed owners (please confirm):
- VPC peering / routing: Helix infra (action: provide VPC ID & peering CIDR list) — requested by 2027-08-12
- IP allowlist / egress IPs: Helix infra to provide static egress IPs OR agree to use tunnel/proxy; template attached (network-allowlist-template.csv) — requested by 2027-08-12
- SSO / SAML (Okta): Helix SSO admin to share IdP metadata and test user (saml-test@helixanalytics.com) — requested by 2027-08-16
- Secrets / KMS: decision on customer-managed KMS vs Redwood-managed key; if customer-managed, Helix to provide key ARN and access policy by 2027-08-16
- Firewall/proxy NAT rules: Helix netops to confirm any outbound restrictions (we can fall back to regional hosted endpoints) — requested by 2027-08-12

Redwood owners: 
- Tech lead / setup: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — will own peering runbook and early validation steps
- SAML onboarding & test: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.com) — will own SSO config and test plan
- PM/tracking: me (Karthik) — will own MAP document, HubSpot milestones, and the overall target close cadence

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.pdf (draft MAP with milestones), network-allowlist-template.csv

Next steps I suggest (please reply inline with confirmations / changes):
1) Helix confirms owners for VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO admin, and KMS by EOD 2027-08-10.
2) Helix shares VPC ID + preliminary CIDR list and egress IPs by 2027-08-12.
3) Redwood sends peering runbook + test checklist within 24 hours of receiving CIDR and VPC details.
4) Schedule a 30-min connectivity dry run with Ben + Helix infra for week of 8/16.

If any of the dates above are tight, call that out and we can push the target close.

Thanks — looking forward to locking owners and getting the infra pass in place.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_v1.3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean O'Rourke <sean@helixanalytics.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Helix Tech <infra@helixanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC network & secrets gating — owners, timeline, target close

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. Quick confirmations from our side: 
- I'll be the project sponsor and single point for scheduling.
- I've looped in our infra alias (infra@helixanalytics.com) — Frank Patel (netops lead) will own VPC peering and IP allowlist work.
- For SSO we're on Okta and can provide IdP metadata. Our SSO admin is Priya Narang (priya.narang@helixanalytics.com).
- On KMS: we prefer customer-managed AWS KMS. We need to confirm cross-account key policies; Frank will coordinate.

Timeline looks doable but tight — Frank flagged that we have a change freeze window 2027-08-13 to 2027-08-15 for other production changes; if we need netops involvement during that freeze we should plan around it.

I'll ask Frank and Priya to reply with firm owner confirmations and the requested artifacts (VPC ID, CIDRs, egress IPs, IdP metadata) by 2027-08-12. If anything slips because of the freeze, we'll propose alternate dates.

Sean O'Rourke
Director of Solutions | Helix Analytics
sean@helixanalytics.com

Hi Sean / infra team — looping in Ben as our technical lead for the peering/dry-run. Ben: can you take point on the peering runbook and share the initial checklist once Helix provides VPC ID + CIDRs?

Ben, suggested immediate tasks once Helix provides VPC details: 
- Validate CIDR overlap / route table plan
- Share Terraform snippet and peering acceptance instructions (we'll share both options: manual console + IaC)
- Provision temporary test user for SAML smoke test (use saml-test@helixanalytics.com)
- Run connectivity test plan (curl from a staging host + token authentication)

I'll own the SAML runbook and test plan; I will need a metadata XML and a test service account. If Helix wants, we can run the SSO smoke test concurrently with the peering dry-run.

Thanks — Lauren

Appreciate the quick confirmations, Sean. Two quick operational notes: 
1) If the change freeze (8/13-8/15) will block netops, we can schedule the connectivity dry run for 8/16 or the week after — that still keeps us on track for the 9/2 target close.
2) To speed the KMS conversation, here's an example cross-account policy we typically ask for (I'll paste after this thread) and a short checklist for granting Decrypt/Encrypt to the Redwood service principal. If Helix prefers Redwood-managed key initially, we can do that to unblock testing and switch to customer KMS in a later milestone — whichever you prefer.

I'll update the MAP doc (HubSpot & Drive links below) to reflect the owners and tentative dates; Ben/Lauren will take the technical artifacts as soon as infra shares the VPC/CIDR and IdP metadata.
